title: Source observation record (snapshot form)
description: One public SatNOGS observation as stored in the immutable snapshot. Field names verified live on 2026-08-16 against network.satnogs.org; see docs/SATNOGS_API_RECON.md section 2. Ratified 2026-08-17 by Bob (task A0): removed observation_frequency from required (nullable in practice); confirmed client_metadata is a JSON-encoded string not an object; confirmed center_frequency is null on every record and must never be used as the receiver frequency. Revised 2026-08-17 in A0b review: _schema_version pinned with const so a record written under an older contract cannot silently validate under this one.

ground_station.description: Station id. GROUPING KEY for cold-station splits.

observation_frequency.description: SatNOGS-recorded observation frequency in Hz. Present on most records but not required; the receiver truth is client_metadata.radio.parameters.rx-freq.

center_frequency.description: NULL ON EVERY RECORD INSPECTED. Do not use this field. The receiver frequency is client_metadata.radio.parameters.rx-freq, accessed by parsing client_metadata as a JSON string.

tle1.description: TLE line 1. Present on 100% of records inspected.

tle2.description: TLE line 2. Present on 100% of records inspected.

max_altitude.description: API-reported peak elevation in degrees. Used to VALIDATE our SGP4 output, not as a feature or physics input. Verified to 0.18 deg agreement against SGP4 on the stored TLE.

status.description: Observation status from SatNOGS. Silver label.

waterfall.description: Artifact URL on wasabisys, a separate failure domain from the API host. Null means artifact-unusable; null never means negative label.

waterfall_status.description: SILVER label. 'unknown' stays unlabelled throughout the pipeline. Null or missing waterfall URL means artifact-unusable, never a negative training example. Not filterable via the API (returns HTTP 400); filter client-side.

client_version.description: Raw client version string. Carries +N.g<sha> and .dirty suffixes. Normalise before grouping; at least six client families exist and 6% of records carry no version.

client_family.description: Derived: client_version normalised to the base release string. GROUPING KEY for client-family holdouts. null when client_version is null.

client_metadata.description: JSON-ENCODED STRING, not a nested object. Parse with json.loads(). Useful keys: rx-freq (receiver frequency in Hz; this is the reliable frequency truth), samp-rate-rx (scientific notation string, do NOT use as bandwidth for pixel mapping), lo-offset, ppm, doppler-correction-per-sec, rigctl-port, radio.name, radio.version. Present on 94% of records. Null on remainder.

_retrieved_at.description: UTC timestamp when this record was fetched by the snapshot builder.

_raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw API page response bytes. Always present.

_waterfall_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded waterfall PNG bytes. Null when the waterfall URL is null or the download failed.

_schema_version.description: Pins the record to the contract version that wrote it. Bumping schema_version above means bumping this const too, and records stored under an earlier version validate against their own pinned copy of the contract, not this one.
